import "date"

// ── Clasificador tarifario CFE (regiones Central/Norte/etc.) ──
// Los timestamps en InfluxDB ahora son UTC real (colector_energia.py corregido).
// México no observa horario de verano desde 2022 → offset fijo UTC-6 todo el año.

nesimoLunes = (y, mes, n) => {
  d1 = time(v: y + "-" + mes + "-01T00:00:00Z")
  wd = date.weekDay(t: d1)
  offset = (if wd <= 1 then 1 - wd else 8 - wd) + (n - 1) * 7
  return date.add(d: duration(v: offset * 86400000000000), to: d1)
}

clasifica = (t) => {
  // Convertimos a hora local (UTC-6 fijo) ANTES de sacar mes/día/hora.
  tLocal = date.sub(d: 6h, from: t)

  y = string(v: date.year(t: tLocal))

  // bordes móviles de temporada (comparados en el mismo espacio "local")
  abr1   = time(v: y + "-04-01T00:00:00Z")
  wdA    = date.weekDay(t: abr1)
  domAbr = date.add(d: duration(v: (if wdA == 0 then 0 else 7 - wdA) * 86400000000000), to: abr1)
  oct31  = time(v: y + "-10-31T00:00:00Z")
  domOct = date.sub(d: duration(v: date.weekDay(t: oct31) * 86400000000000), from: oct31)
  feb1   = time(v: y + "-02-01T00:00:00Z")
  ago1   = time(v: y + "-08-01T00:00:00Z")

  temp =
    if tLocal >= domAbr and tLocal < ago1 then "ver"
    else if tLocal >= domOct or tLocal < feb1 then "inv"
    else "med"

  // festivos Art. 74 LFT (sin fracción IX): fijos + lunes móviles
  hoy0     = date.truncate(t: tLocal, unit: 1d)
  mm       = date.month(t: tLocal)
  dd       = date.monthDay(t: tLocal)
  fijo     = (mm == 1 and dd == 1) or (mm == 5 and dd == 1) or (mm == 9 and dd == 16) or (mm == 12 and dd == 25)
  movil    =
    hoy0 == nesimoLunes(y: y, mes: "02", n: 1) or   // Constitución
    hoy0 == nesimoLunes(y: y, mes: "03", n: 3) or   // Juárez
    hoy0 == nesimoLunes(y: y, mes: "11", n: 3)      // Revolución
  festivo  = fijo or movil

  h   = date.hour(t: tLocal)
  wdR = date.weekDay(t: tLocal)
  wd  = if festivo then 0 else wdR   // festivo se trata como domingo

  return
    if temp == "ver" then
      (if wd >= 1 and wd <= 5 then
        (if h >= 1 and h < 6 then "Base"
         else if h >= 20 and h < 22 then "Punta"
         else "Intermedia")
       else if wd == 6 then
        (if h >= 1 and h < 7 then "Base" else "Intermedia")
       else
        (if h < 19 then "Base" else "Intermedia"))
    else if temp == "inv" then
      (if wd >= 1 and wd <= 5 then
        (if h < 6 then "Base"
         else if h >= 18 and h < 22 then "Punta"
         else "Intermedia")
       else if wd == 6 then
        (if h < 8 then "Base"
         else if h >= 19 and h < 21 then "Punta"
         else if h >= 21 then "Base"
         else "Intermedia")
       else
        (if h < 18 then "Base" else "Intermedia"))
    else  // med: feb–mar y ago–oct
      (if wd >= 1 and wd <= 5 then
        (if h < 6 then "Base"
         else if h >= 19 and h < 22 then "Punta"
         else "Intermedia")
       else if wd == 6 then
        (if h < 7 then "Base" else "Intermedia")
       else
        (if h < 19 or h >= 23 then "Base" else "Intermedia"))
}

// ── Esqueleto de bandas (con clasificación doble: actual + anterior) ──
esqueleto = from(bucket: "energia")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "energia_periodo" and r._field == "u_kw")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: true, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      banda: clasifica(t: r._time),
      bandaPrev: clasifica(t: date.sub(d: 5m, from: r._time))
  }))

serie = (nombre) =>
  esqueleto
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,
        _value: if r.banda == nombre or r.bandaPrev == nombre then 20000.0 else (float(v: "NaN")),
        banda: nombre
    }))
    |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r._value or r._value != r._value or r._value == 20000.0)
    |> group(columns: ["banda"])

union(tables: [
  serie(nombre: "Base"),
  serie(nombre: "Intermedia"),
  serie(nombre: "Punta")
])

from(bucket: "energia")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "energia_periodo")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "u_kw")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: max, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, serie: "Demanda CFE" }))
  |> group(columns: ["serie"])

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "energia_periodo")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "gen_kw")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, serie: "Cogeneración" }))
  |> group(columns: ["serie"])

from(bucket: "energia")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "energia_periodo")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "u_kw" or r._field == "gen_kw")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: max, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.u_kw and exists r.gen_kw)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value: r.u_kw + r.gen_kw,
      serie: "Carga total planta"
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["serie"])

cfe = from(bucket: "energia")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "energia_periodo" and r._field == "u_kw")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: max, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "cfe", _value: r._value }))

pm = from(bucket: "energia")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "modbus" and r.name == "pm8240_planta")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "potencia_activa_total_w")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: max, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "pm", _value: r._value / 1000.0 }))

ion = from(bucket: "energia")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ion8650" and r.log == "Hist_high_Log")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "kW_tot_high")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: max, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "ion", _value: r._value }))

union(tables: [cfe, pm, ion])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.cfe and exists r.pm and exists r.ion)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r.ion - r.pm - r.cfe, serie: "Otra planta" }))
  |> group(columns: ["serie"])

// ── Formateador de fecha/hora legible ──
fmt = (t) => {
  y  = string(v: date.year(t: t))
  mo = date.month(t: t)
  moS = if mo < 10 then "0" + string(v: mo) else string(v: mo)
  d  = date.monthDay(t: t)
  dS = if d < 10 then "0" + string(v: d) else string(v: d)
  h  = date.hour(t: t)
  hS = if h < 10 then "0" + string(v: h) else string(v: h)
  mi = date.minute(t: t)
  miS = if mi < 10 then "0" + string(v: mi) else string(v: mi)
  return y + "-" + moS + "-" + dS + "  " + hS + ":" + miS
}

        (if h < 19 then "Base" else "Intermedia"))
    else if temp == "inv" then
      (if wd >= 1 and wd <= 5 then
        (if h < 6 then "Base"
         else if h >= 18 and h < 22 then "Punta"
         else "Intermedia")
       else if wd == 6 then
        (if h < 8 then "Base"
         else if h >= 19 and h < 21 then "Punta"
         else if h >= 21 then "Base"
         else "Intermedia")
       else
        (if h < 18 then "Base" else "Intermedia"))
    else  // med: feb–mar y ago–oct
      (if wd >= 1 and wd <= 5 then
        (if h < 6 then "Base"
         else if h >= 19 and h < 22 then "Punta"
         else "Intermedia")
       else if wd == 6 then
        (if h < 7 then "Base" else "Intermedia")
       else
        (if h < 19 or h >= 23 then "Base" else "Intermedia"))
}

esqueleto = from(bucket: "energia")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "energia_periodo" and r._field == "u_kw")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: true, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      banda: clasifica(t: r._time),
      bandaPrev: clasifica(t: date.sub(d: 5m, from: r._time))
  }))

serie = (nombre) =>
  esqueleto
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,
        _value: if r.banda == nombre or r.bandaPrev == nombre then 20000.0 else (float(v: "NaN")),
        banda: nombre
    }))
    |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r._value or r._value != r._value or r._value == 20000.0)
    |> group(columns: ["banda"])

union(tables: [
  serie(nombre: "Base"),
  serie(nombre: "Intermedia"),
  serie(nombre: "Punta")
])
